title: Utilities and Experimental
summary: This module provides a collection of general-purpose utility functions, experimental features, hooks, callbacks, and development tools for the CrewAI framework.

nodes.label: General Utilities
nodes.title: General Utilities Module
nodes.description: Provides common utility functions for logging, serialization, string manipulation, task output management, and security configurations.

nodes.label: Hooks and Callbacks
nodes.title: Hooks and Callbacks Module
nodes.description: Offers a flexible system for defining and managing hooks that execute before or after LLM and tool calls, enabling custom logic and logging.

nodes.label: Experimental Features
nodes.title: Experimental Features Module
nodes.description: Contains features under active development, such as conversational AI capabilities and evaluation tools for agents and crews.

nodes.label: Testing and Development Tools
nodes.title: Testing and Development Tools Module
nodes.description: Includes utilities for testing, development, and telemetry, such as version bumping, documentation checks, and usage tracking.

nodes.label: LLM Integration
nodes.title: LLM Integration
nodes.description: Handles interactions with various Large Language Models (LLMs) and their specific APIs.

nodes.label: Agent Management
nodes.title: Agent Management
nodes.description: Manages the lifecycle and execution of AI agents, including their interactions with LLMs and tools.

nodes.label: Event System
nodes.title: Event System
nodes.description: Manages and dispatches events within the CrewAI framework, enabling logging, tracing, and inter-component communication.

groups.label: Core Utilities
groups.title: Core Utility Functions and Hooks
groups.description: This group encompasses essential utility functions for common tasks and a flexible system for injecting custom logic via hooks and callbacks into the CrewAI workflow.

groups.label: Experimental & Dev Tools
groups.title: Experimental Features and Development Tools
groups.description: This group includes features under active development, such as conversational AI and evaluation tools, alongside utilities for testing, development, and telemetry.

groups.label: Framework Dependencies
groups.title: Core Framework Dependencies
groups.description: These modules represent core components of the CrewAI framework that are utilized or extended by the utilities and experimental features.
